import subprocess, sys
from experiments.transformer_pp import static_sos_acceptance as adapter
from scaffolds.transformer.acceptance import test_paths
from scaffolds.transformer.configs import config_to_dict
paths = set()
for key in adapter.CONTROLS:
    config = adapter.static_config(*key)
    spec = adapter.experiment_spec(config, entry_module=adapter.__name__)
    paths.update(test_paths(spec, config_to_dict(config), resolved_backend='mosaic', cpu=True))
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-c', 'scaffolds/transformer/pyproject.toml', *sorted(paths), '-m', 'not gpu', '-k', 'not distributed', '--maxfail=3']))
PY
